title: Time Value Calculator
shortDescription: A Python time-value calculator for present value, future value, annuities, and perpetuities.
longDescription: UCLA summer project 1: a TimeValue class that turns financial formulas into reusable Python methods. The project explores translating economic models into usable calculations.

title: Portfolio Analysis & Optimization
shortDescription: A Python notebook exploring daily-return correlations, diversification, and portfolio optimization.
longDescription: UCLA summer project 2: exploring the relationships between assets and what an optimization model defines as the best portfolio. The notebook screenshot shows a correlation matrix of daily returns.
